## We’re driven by our valuesWe’re driven  by our values

- ## Think





We are only as good as the questions we’re willing to ask, the debates we’re willing to have, the blind spots we’re willing to face. Our unique thinking results in unique products that are changing the world.

- ## Do





We make things happen and prioritize progress over perfection. Ownership and accountability are at the core of how we operate. We take initiative without waiting for direction.

- ## Serve





Here, we serve. We serve our mission. Our leaders serve their teams. Our teams serve each other. We remain humble and always remember that the team is more important than any one individual.

### Senior Security Software Engineer

San Francisco/New York—Engineering

As a Security Software Engineer, you will build foundational security systems that protect our users and infrastructure. You will design and implement robust, scalable security services, acting as a primary partner for engineering teams to build secure-by-design solutions into our platform. You will take ownership of core functions such as authentication (login, MFA), identity management (SCIM, RBAC), secret management, and more. Your work will be crucial in maintaining and hardening compliance (e.g., SOC 2) and protecting sensitive data across our organization.

**The Team:**

The Infrastructure and Security team at Hover ensures the scalability, reliability, and security of our platform, empowering engineers to build and deploy applications faster, safer, and with greater stability. This collaborative team is composed of engineers with expertise in cloud infrastructure, security, automation, and CI/CD best practices. We handle everything from Kubernetes environments and cloud architecture to securing user authentication and automating vulnerability detection.

Our mission is to make the best path the easiest path by providing robust automation, consistent patterns, and secure-by-design principles. We partner with engineering teams to tackle challenges like managing rich geospatial and machine learning workloads, hardening cloud infrastructure, and implementing security features across our stack (Ruby, TypeScript, Docker, GCP, Terraform, and more).

Team members are supported with professional growth opportunities, a strong focus on learning, and a culture that values collaboration, innovation, and the continuous improvement of our systems and security posture. Join us to work on cutting-edge challenges that are critical to the foundation of Hover’s success.

[Apply nowSenior Security Software Engineer](https://hover.to/job-posts/8003885)

### Customer Success Manager

San Francisco/New York—Customer Success

Hover is looking for a Customer Success Manager to help our mid-market customers adopt, engage with, and realize value from Hover’s product suite.

This is a scaled Customer Success role for someone who is energized by solving problems across a large book of accounts rather than working deeply with a small number of enterprise customers. You’ll own the customer lifecycle from onboarding through renewal readiness, helping customers get started quickly, adopt the right products, and uncover opportunities for deeper value over time.

You’ll work closely with Renewal Managers, Solutions, Data, and Product to support customer outcomes, identify expansion signals, and turn customer feedback into insights that help Hover continue building a better platform.

[Apply nowCustomer Success Manager](https://hover.to/job-posts/7993889)

### Senior Customer Experience Operations Manager

San Francisco/New York—Business Operations & Growth

Hover's Inbound Customer Experience team is one of the company's most consistently recognized differentiators — and we're looking for a leader who can run it with equal parts rigor and empathy. You'll take the reins of an operation that's already thriving: a ~50-person BPO team across three countries with strong tenure, strong culture, and a track record customers love. But you're not just here to maintain it — you're here to lead it through its next chapter, as AI absorbs more transactional volume and the remaining work shifts toward judgment, critical thinking, and human-in-the-loop review. This is a rare combination: a proven, high-functioning team to inherit, real ownership over its evolution, and a direct hand in shaping what "great support" looks like as the industry changes around you.

[Apply nowSenior Customer Experience Operations Manager](https://hover.to/job-posts/8092495)

## Life at Hover

We are united by a clear mission: to make the homeowner journey easy, transparent, and fun. We’re obsessive about our culture, uncompromising about a high caliber of talent, and deeply committed to our customers.

[Apply now](https://hover.to/careers)

## Thriving together

At Hover, we believe that fostering organic connections and strong team dynamics is key to innovation and maintaining our amazing company culture. We prioritize hiring in our Hubs of San Francisco and New York City, while a dedicated collaboration budget ensures that our remote teammates are able to come together in real life to build connection, culture, and community.

## Innovation

Hover's annual Hack-a-thon serves as one of our longest standing traditions where the entire company commits to multiple days of unfettered creativity and innovation. Many of the winning hacks live on in the products and continue to inspire the next breakthrough.

![A photo of a large group of Hover employees gathered in a communal area for a company-wide function. The people are all smiling and seated in chairs looking toward a speaker who is out of the frame.](https://hover.to/hs-fs/hubfs/web-react/pages/careers-page/team-gathering.jpg?width=2400&height=1800&name=team-gathering.jpg)

## Compensation philosophy

- ## Philosophy pillars





Hover’s pay philosophy is simple–we establish competitive market-based compensation and align rewards with our high performance culture. We set pay standards using relevant market data while also rewarding employees based on their performance, contributions, and impact.

- ## Offers at Hover





Our compensation bands are benchmarked against all SF Bay Area technology companies, refreshed annually and designed to give employees room to grow over time. Our compensation bands are tied to a leveling framework that provides clarity of expectations in each role.

- ## Merit cycles





We run two merit cycles a year for non-quota carrying employees, typically at the end of Q1 and Q3, following a performance review cycle. Employees with at least 2 months tenure before the start of the merit cycle are eligible to participate. Quota carrying employees participate in one cycle per year.


## Growing together

Hover is committed to building teams that serve our customers, each other and the communities we’re a part of. We do our best work in an environment that fosters growth, diversity, recognition, and collaboration. To that end, we invest in a number of programs and initiatives that fuel our growth.

- ## DEIB





We’ll improve the homeowner journey by making Hover feel like home for every employee. Diversity is vital for our ability to grow and innovate. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) are an integral component of Hover’s commitment to create an inclusive culture and foster a sense of belonging.

- ## Learning and Development





Hover's Learning and Development programs provide Hoverites with access to high-impact, meaningful learning and career development opportunities. We partner with our employees to offer the right resources, experiences, and tools to support growth at all levels. Current learning opportunities include: Hover's in-house manager training program, leadership development training with Middle Path, learning stipends and more.

- ## Mentorship program





Hoverites have an opportunity to reflect and learn in a one-on-one mentoring partnership. Our program provides mentees with a sounding board, insight, advice, and enduring professional relationships.

## Interview best practicesSession best practices

At Hover we have a thorough interview process to ensure we're building our team the right way. To help you navigate this process, check out hacks identified by our hiring teams and past candidates.

## Communication

To thrive at Hover, exceptional communication skills are key. We value active listening, clarity and conciseness, and empathy. During interviews, ask clarifying questions to ensure you have the proper understanding of the question. Take your time to think of the most pertinent examples.

## Critical Thinking

Building a new platform and data category requires problem-solving and critical thinking. At Hover, we value diverse perspectives and believe great ideas can come from anyone. We’re not just looking for the right answer—we care about how you approach the problem. In interviews, highlight your problem-solving skills and show how you think through challenges. Your approach matters as much as the solution.

## Growth Mindset

Hover is expanding across markets, products, and teams, seeking passionate individuals committed to developing their skills and adopting new tools to propel our growth. We value team members who are eager to grow, both personally and alongside the company. During your interview, reflect on how you stay current in your field and seek out opportunities for learning and development.

## Impact

We seek individuals energized by the startup atmosphere and eager to make meaningful contributions to our company's success. Integrity, grit, and teamwork are paramount. Before your interview, reflect on times you went against the grain, had to persist, and work with teammates to make an impact.

## The interview process

Please note that this is a generalization, and for a more specific understanding of the interview process for the role you’ve applied to, please ask your Recruiter. Our goal is to provide ample opportunity for you to demonstrate your ability to succeed in the role. We believe the best interview processes are objective, transparent, and consistent, and that is what we aim to provide you with.

- ## Step 1



## Preliminary screening





A Recruiter will provide an overview of the job, team, and what it’s like to work at Hover. We’ll dive into relevant professional experience with background and behavioral questions aimed at assessing role fit.

- ## Step 2



## Hiring Manager interview





Usually you’ll speak with the Hiring Manager via Zoom video for 30-45 minutes. You can expect both behavioral and technical/skills-based questions. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the product if you haven’t already and come prepared to share feedback and ask questions.

- ## Step 3



## Technical assessment





For some of our more technical roles there may be a live coding assessment or case study to assess problem solving skills. We intend for the assessment to be practical, related to the work we do at Hover, and fun.

- ## Step 4



## Onsite interview





In an effort to build rapport and create an environment of collaboration we aim to conduct as much of the interviews in-person as possible, in either our San Francisco or New York office. We’d be happy to distribute the interviews across multiple days to accommodate your schedule.


## Common competencies

Hover’s Common Competencies are a shared set of skills that give the company a competitive advantage in the market. They are fundamental to Hover’s ability to innovate, collaborate effectively, and deliver outsized value to our customers. These competencies not only shape our interview process but are also leveraged in our twice-annual performance reviews, providing a shared language for what success looks like at Hover.

- ## Thinking critically





You continuously synthesize information to identify and analyze problems, themes, and their impact.

- ## Planning





You set clear objectives and allocate time and resources to achieve them.

- ## Demonstrating domain expertise





You demonstrate technical skills and commitment to continuous improvement in your field.

- ## Leading change





You proactively improve and innovate on the status quo.

- ## Driving ownership





You hold yourself and others accountable for individual, team, or company goals.

- ## Creating alignment





You actively communicate, influence, and engage others to get all parts of the organization moving in one direction.

- ## Communicating effectively





You provide relevant information while engaging in respectful dialogue and recognize others’ diverse viewpoints.

- ## Building high performing teams





You continuously raise the bar by recruiting the best talent and coaching team members to reach their full potential.

- ## Being customer focused





You consistently prioritize the needs of the customer (internal and external) in building products, processes, and systems.
